question: Identical twin pairs share handedness about 80% of the time. If 1 in 10 people is left-handed, what % of random stranger pairs would?
move: Before admiring how often two things agree, work out how often strangers would.
ask: Before I admire how often two things agree, how often would strangers agree?
trap: Reading 80% agreement between twins as strong evidence for genes.
hint: Add the chance both are right-handed to the chance both are left-handed.
simply: Line up 100 pairs of strangers: about 81 are both right-handed and 1 both left-handed. A 2022 pooling of twin studies found identical twins agreeing 80.5% of the time and non-identical twins 79.3%. Genes explain about a quarter of handedness.

diagram.label: pairs of strangers
diagram.caption: 81 + 1 = 82 in 100 stranger pairs share handedness, more than identical twins' 80.
